Will the Republican Party win the Kansas Senate?

Rules
Leg 1
Will the Republican Party win the Kansas Senate?

This market will resolve based on which party wins U.S. Senate Kansas. Market resolves to "YES" if the winning candidate is affiliated with the specified party, "NO" otherwise. A candidate running on a fusion ticket counts for every party on that ticket, so more than one party's market can resolve "YES" for the same race.

Data source: Official election results from relevant election authorities
Market resolves to "YES" if the condition is met, "NO" if not met
Resolution is based on final, certified election results
In case of recounts or legal challenges, resolution may be delayed until final results are certified

Disclaimer: Susquehanna may, at our sole discretion, update the rules, outcomes, or resolution of this market at any time, including after the resolution date or end date.
